ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 22 overnight screening runs with 19 high-conviction votes, making it the single strongest consensus idea. The stock sold off 4.6% on Aug 28 to ~$217.55 — not on fundamental weakness, but on macro noise from Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks — creating a defined-risk re-entry opportunity after the most impressive beat-and-raise in AI semiconductor history. Q2 revenue of $96.2B beat consensus by ~$4B (+4.6%), Q3 guide of ~$107-108B exceeded the $104B consensus, and FY2028 revenue growth was guided at +70% vs ~35-45% street expectations — nearly 2x the upside surprise. At ~25x forward earnings despite 106% YoY revenue growth, the valuation discount to the underlying growth rate is stark, with 58 of 61 analysts rating it Buy/Strong Buy and a consensus price target of $323.42 (~48% upside).
ideas.catalyst: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference ~Sep 10, 2026; FOMC Sep 15-16 rate decision (hold outcome would re-rate AI capex outlook); Q3 FY2027 earnings report ~Nov 2026
ideas.edge: Stock at ~$217.55 vs consensus analyst PT of $323.42 — ~48% gap. FY2028 revenue guide of +70% is nearly 2x the ~35-45% street expectation. Trades at only 25x forward earnings despite 106% YoY revenue growth. 58 of 61 analysts Buy/Strong Buy.
ideas.bull_case: Post-earnings drift historically favors NVDA after blowout prints; a Fed hold on Sep 15-16 removes the primary macro overhang and could trigger rapid re-rating toward analyst targets, with the GS tech conference as an additional near-term catalyst.
ideas.bear_case: A 25bp September rate hike could compress high-duration tech multiples further; post-earnings supply overhangs and profit-taking from recent buyers could extend the pullback below $200 support before any recovery.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc.
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 22 overnight runs with unanimous high-conviction votes (22/22) — the only idea to achieve this distinction — driven by a confluence of catalysts that screens identified as a rare multi-factor setup. As the dominant HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) supplier for NVDA's GB200/Blackwell platform, SKHY receives a direct demand halo from NVDA's blowout Q2 print and guidance raise. The stock has pulled back ~11% from its Aug 17 high of $178 to ~$158 despite Needham raising its PT to $220 on Aug 24, a $500B+ locked NVDA/SK Group AI infrastructure supply partnership, an active 40 trillion won share buyback, confirmed Temasek sovereign wealth investment, and Q2 fundamentals showing revenue +51% sequentially and EPS +103% YoY at a P/E of just 7.39x.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA post-earnings AI memory demand halo active now; Needham $220 PT raised Aug 24; Dalian NAND plant restart and US Indiana HBM fab groundbreaking underway; next SK Hynix earnings cycle Oct 2026
ideas.edge: Stock ~$158 vs Needham PT of $220 (~39% upside) and consensus 14-analyst average PT of $245.43 (~52% upside). P/E of 7.39x vs sector average. Revenue +40.8% YoY, net income +108% YoY, ROIC ~73.5%. 40 trillion won buyback active as a floor catalyst.
ideas.bull_case: NVDA's confirmed +70% FY2028 revenue growth guide directly implies accelerating HBM procurement from SKHY; the 11% pullback from highs against a backdrop of a $500B supply partnership lock-in, sovereign wealth backing, and live buyback creates an asymmetric re-entry with multiple near-term re-rating triggers.

ideas.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (Nasdaq-100 ETF)
ideas.thesis: QQQ appeared in 19 of 22 overnight runs as a macro-event vehicle rather than a directional bet, with 17 of 19 conviction votes at medium — reflecting the binary nature of the setup. Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech on Aug 28 has flipped the September 15-16 FOMC into a live coin-flip (market-implied hike odds ~31-56% across runs), with the Nasdaq down 0.7% on Aug 28 in response. Both bull and bear outcomes have defined risk via QQQ options, and VIX at 14.51 makes premium on near-term structures historically cheap for a binary macro event of this magnitude. Screens consistently flagged this as an options play — either put spreads as a hedge or call spreads to capture the relief rally if the Fed holds.
ideas.catalyst: FOMC rate decision September 15-16, 2026 — binary hold-or-hike outcome; Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference ~Sep 10 as interim sentiment catalyst
ideas.edge: VIX at 14.51 — historically cheap premium for defined-risk options structures ahead of a ~50/50 binary macro event. QQQ options are deeply liquid with tight spreads. S&P 500 up 19.4% YoY provides a bullish macro backdrop that would amplify a relief rally if the Fed holds.
ideas.bull_case: A September hold (MUFG base case, ~56-69% probability) would directly relieve rate-sensitivity pressure on high-duration Nasdaq 100 names, likely triggering a gap-up relief rally that a pre-positioned call spread captures with capped downside.
ideas.bear_case: A 25bp hike would be the first in this cycle and could materially compress Nasdaq 100 P/E multiples; put spread protection is cheap at current VIX but a hike-driven selloff could be deeper than the hedge offsets if held without downside protection.
